articles.headline: Tonda Eckert 'forever grateful' for Southampton support during 'Spygate' fallout
articles.description: Tonda Eckert is relieved to finally draw a line under the 'Spygate' scandal and will "forever be grateful" for Southampton's support.

articles.headline: Southampton's Tonda Eckert given suspended six-week ban for 'Spygate' role
articles.description: Southampton manager Tonda Eckert has avoided a ban for his role in "Spygate" after he was handed a six-week suspended sentence and a £28,000 fine.

articles.headline: Gavin Bazunu confirms withdrawal from Republic of Ireland matches against Israel
articles.description: Bolton Wanderers goalkeeper Gavin Bazunu has confirmed he has refused to participate in the Republic of Ireland's controversial Nations League fixtures with Israel as a matter of "principle".

images.name: Gavin Bazunu [1296x729]
images.caption: Republic of Ireland goalkeeper Gavin Bazunu has confirmed that he will not play either of the two Nations League fixtures against Israel.

articles.headline: Humphrey Ker steps down from Wrexham board
articles.description: Humphrey Ker, the man who masterminded the Hollywood takeover at Wrexham, has stepped down from the club's board.

articles.headline: UK PM Burnham wants 'outdated' football drinking ban scrapped
articles.description: A ban on football fans drinking in the stands during matches is outdated, discriminatory and should be scrapped, Andy Burnham said.

images.credit: Jonathan Brady / POOL / AFP via Getty Images

articles.headline: Phil Parkinson grateful for Wrexham fans' support after 'difficult week'
articles.description: Phil Parkinson was touched by Wrexham fans' backing after a "difficult week" and hopes the last-gasp win against Southampton can breathe new life into their campaign.
